title: Crypto Twitter
description: Crypto Creator tracks influential voices on X (Twitter) who shape narratives and markets across DeFi, NFTs, and infrastructure. Posts are scored for “Signal”, timely, original, and verifiable insights, while hype, misinformation, and low-effort amplification are penalized.

title: NFTs

title: Bitcoin
description: Bitcoin is the original decentralized currency and settlement network. Key discussions cover BTC markets, consensus and security, scaling (L2s, ordinals), institutional adoption, and policy or macroeconomic narratives.

title: Ethereum

title: Flow

It pairs Cadence (a purpose-built smart-contract language) with an EVM-equivalent execution environment, a pipelined multi-role node architecture, and a rich developer toolkit to power NFTs, games, and brand experiences at scale.

title: Base

It is open source, designed for interoperability with Ethereum L1 and other chains, and aims to progressively decentralize while supporting developer velocity and large-scale user adoption.

title: Solana
description: Solana is a high-throughput Layer-1 blockchain popular for consumer apps and memecoins. On-topic content spans SOL markets, major ecosystem tools, validator/MEV updates, and infrastructure upgrades.

title: Monad
description: Monad is an EVM-compatible Layer-1 built for parallel execution and high throughput. Its design includes MonadBFT consensus and MonadDB, aiming to reduce latency while scaling developer-friendly infrastructure.

It links Bitcoin L1, its meta-protocols (BRC-20s, Runes), and over 70 external blockchains via LayerZero, allowing users to bridge, convert, and move assets securely within and beyond Bitcoin.

title: Hyperliquid

Built around HyperBFT consensus, HyperCore order-book primitives, and an EVM-compatible HyperEVM, it combines one-block finality and institutional throughput with permissionless smart-contract composability.

title: IOPn

title: VOOI

title: Arbitrum
description: Arbitrum is a suite of Ethereum scaling technologies that operates as a blockchain protocol designed to make transactions faster and cheaper while maintaining compatibility with Ethereum. Arbitrum chains use an underlying EVM-compatible chain (such as Ethereum) for settlement and fraud proofs, coming in two main forms: Arbitrum Rollup Chains and Arbitrum AnyTrust Chains. These chains enable users to deploy smart contracts and use decentralized applications with lower costs and higher throughput compared to Ethereum mainnet.

title: Cookie.fun
description: Cookie.fun (Cookie DAO) is a developer- and agent-focused data layer that turns raw on-chain + social signals into actionable analytics, mindshare metrics, and incentive flows for builders and AI agents. $COOKIE tokens gate advanced access (staking, farming, multi-airdrop rewards) while Cookie APIs, Cookie Snaps, and the DataSwarm provide low-latency feeds and granular filters to power agentic InfoFi workflows and creator incentives.

title: DePin
description: DePIN (Decentralized Physical Infrastructure Networks) are crypto‑native marketplaces that fund, verify, and pay for real‑world infrastructure such as wireless, storage, compute, and sensor networks. Individuals supply hardware and earn tokens or usage fees for provably delivering service, while applications buy those services on demand. This bottom‑up model aims to scale physical networks faster and cheaper than centralized providers by aligning incentives on‑chain.

Build, craft, and wage RTS battles in a vast world; conquer territory, engage in politics, own your heroes, units, resources, land, and gear as tradable assets; and risk-manage adventures across Green, Yellow, and high-stakes Red zones.

Rooted in the underdog story of the “great blizzard” and the legendary community takeover, $PENGU symbolizes resilience, culture, and collective triumph.

title: Limitless
description: Limitless is a high-frequency prediction-markets exchange on Base where users trade natural-language markets (crypto, stocks, events) via an EVM order-book and conditional tokens. It features capital-efficient primitives — merge/split shares, Negrisk category markets with No→Yes conversion, and an LP rewards program — plus a public API and on-chain conditional tokens contract for integrations. Market resolution is typically sourced from Pyth and the platform exposes analytical endpoints (Dune) and docs for builders.

title: MegaETH

title: Cardano
description: Cardano is a peer-reviewed, proof-of-stake blockchain built for security, scalability, and formalized, research-first development. Powered by the Ouroboros consensus and Haskell-based implementations, it pairs a robust staking/governance model and smart-contract capabilities (Plutus) with a strong community governance and ecosystem stewardship through groups like Intersect and PRAGMA. Ada is the native token used for value transfer, staking, and participating in on-chain governance.

The network’s architecture allows for the creation of sovereign, efficient and fully interoperable public and private layer 1 (L1) blockchains which leverage the Avalanche Consensus Mechanism to achieve high throughput and near-instant transaction finality.

Alpha Protocol (Theoriqs) is an onchain infrastructure that powers autonomous AI agents and coordinated swarms (AlphaSwarm) to optimize liquidity, execute dynamic trading strategies, and discover yield across DeFi protocols—enabling institutional-grade, adaptive capital management with low trust assumptions.
Agent swarms autonomously shift capital between pools, vaults, lending venues, and staking opportunities in real time to maximize returns and minimize risk.

It supports omnichain, superchain-style integration and exposes developer APIs and plug-and-play modules for tournaments, predictions, and agent-driven competitions so builders can rapidly add monetizable engagement layers.

title: Espresso
description: Espresso is a decentralized confirmation layer built to give rollups and appchains fast, secure, real-time cross-chain composability. The platform provides ~6-second confirmations, Ethereum compatibility, and a modular architecture that enables any chain to interoperate seamlessly without sacrificing security.

title: Claynosaurz
description: Claynosaurz is a clay‑animated character universe and Solana NFT project featuring seven dinosaur species and 10,222 unique collectibles set in the whimsical world of Claynotopia. The brand blends viral short‑form storytelling with on‑chain collectibles, crafting tools (Clay, Claymaker), and IRL activations to bridge digital and physical fandom.

title: Almanak
description: Almanak is a no-code, agent-driven strategy platform for DeFi. Describe what you want; its AI Swarm writes verifiable code, backtests and optimizes it, then deploys the strategy non-custodially through Safe/Zodiac with privacy preserved via TEEs

title: MultichainZ
description: MultichainZ is a non-custodial omnichain credit protocol that lets users borrow against yield-bearing RWAs and crypto assets across multiple chains while offsetting or eliminating borrowing costs through its Yield Offset Engine. Its Omnichain Collateral Engine enables cross-chain borrowing without bridging, unlocking capital efficiency, composable RWA markets, and real-time settlement. Designed for institutions and permissionless users alike, MultichainZ merges TradFi-grade credit architecture with DeFi composability and transparency.

title: Myriad Markets
description: Prediction Markets for everything! From crypto, politics and sports to gaming, culture and technology. Trade your opinion.

It offers wallet-native, no-KYC play with transparent verification and fast crypto withdrawals, combining casino titles with decentralized raffles and leaderboard events on EVM networks.

Powered by Animechain, a purpose-built L3, Animecoin fuels a “Full Stack Anime” strategy that combines original IP, consumer platforms like Anime.com, and blockchain infrastructure to unite fans and creators.

title: Somnia
description: Somnia is an EVM-compatible Layer-1 designed for real-time consumer apps like gaming, on-chain social, and the metaverse. With sub-second finality and high throughput, it supports the SOMI token and an active developer ecosystem.

title: MEGAWEAPON

It enables personalized dApps, wallet insights, decentralized messaging markets, and AI-driven analytics while ensuring users retain ownership of their data and earn rewards through the BluAI token. Bluwhale aims to replace Web2 data monopolies with a user-sovereign economy built on transparency, interoperability, and shared intelligence.

Its key innovation is native, rebasing yield for bridged assets (apeUSD, apeETH) delivered via on-chain yield routes and configurable yield modes (automatic, void, delegate), plus built-in developer and bridge tooling (ApePortal, RPCs, explorers) for easy onboarding.

title: Covalent
description: Covalent’s SpeedRun is a prompt-to-earn platform that combines GoldRush’s low-latency, multi-chain on-chain data with instant, internet-native payments and one-click contract deployment so builders can monetize prompts and agent interactions in real time. Backing SpeedRun is the Covalent Network — a decentralized, proof-based data availability layer (EWM / Block Specimens / Block Results) that indexes 100+ chains and settles operator rewards and governance via the native CXT token.

description: Limit Break is a Web3 game studio and infrastructure company that brings free-to-play gaming to blockchain by combining polished game experiences (DigiDaigaku) with distribution and payments primitives for NFTs. title: Mindō AI

title: Anoma

Its stack (intent gossip, solvers, fractal instances, validity predicates, Taiga/Typhon execution) supports privacy primitives (ZK, FHE, threshold decryption) for use cases from decentralized exchanges to multiparty barter and runtime rollups.

title: Ostium
description: Ostium is a decentralized, non-custodial exchange that lets users trade perpetuals on global markets—including stocks, commodities, FX, indices, and crypto—directly from their wallet with full transparency and no brokers. Built on Arbitrum, it offers traceable settlement, open-source contracts, and real-time onchain execution across traditional and crypto assets.

title: Artery
